name: Scaleway Generative APIs
short: Scaleway's European serverless inference for open models, with a free token allowance and per-token billing across GLM, Qwen, DeepSeek and more.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Serverless only; also 60 minutes of audio transcription. Applied to the most expensive tokens first, with a 1,000-token minimum billing unit.

plans.name: Batches API
plans.notes: Asynchronous batch requests are billed at half the serverless token rate.

plans.name: Dedicated Deployment
plans.notes: Dedicated capacity without serverless rate limits; provisioned from Scaleway's GPU Instance range.
